title: Implement multi-region analytics replication and per-tenant data residency controls for Console pipelines
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Goal: Provide strong per-tenant data residency controls and resilient multi-region replication for Console usage analytics while preserving real-time observability and minimizing cost. Scope covers ingestion layer, stream replication, regional storage, and console controls/UI for residency flags. Must satisfy EU/UK data residency requirements and provide opt-in regional isolation for regulated customers. We will avoid synchronous cross-region writes for user-facing paths; instead prefer async replication with configurable residency enforcement at the ingestion edge.

Problem statement: Current analytics pipeline writes all telemetry to a single global ClickHouse cluster and S3 bucket. This violates contractual data residency for some customers and increases egress costs. We need a design that: (1) routes raw events to tenant-authorized regions, (2) allows aggregated/global views when permitted (anonymized), and (3) supports operational observability and billing without exposing raw PII across regions.

Non-goals: Replacing the core analytics engine (ClickHouse) in this ticket; full GDPR legal review (will be a separate PM/legal task); rewriting all dashboards — dashboards will be incrementally adapted in follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant residency flag is stored in tenant configuration and exercisable by ingestion gateway at write time.
Ingestion gateway routes raw event writes to regional Kafka topics (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) based on residency flag or IP geolocation fallback.
Cross-region replication pipeline implemented via async CDC jobs that replicate anonymized aggregates to a global analytics cluster when tenant allows.
Backfill job to migrate historical raw events for tenants that opt into regional residency, with progress metrics and resumability.
End-to-end tests validating routing, replication lag under 90s for 95th percentile, and failure mode behavior (local writes succeed when remote region is unavailable).
Console UI exposes residency setting and shows replication status & last-backfill timestamp for each tenant.
Security review completed and encryption-in-transit and at-rest verified for each region (KMS keys per region or tenant as required).
tasks: Design doc: finalize ingestion routing semantics and replication topology (confluence: /wiki/Console-MultiRegion-Analytics)
Ingestion: add per-tenant residency lookup and regional topic routing in ingestion-gateway (edge)
Streaming: create regional Kafka clusters and topic naming convention; deploy replication CDC jobs (ksql / Debezium) to populate regional ClickHouse/Clickhouse-proxy
Storage: provision regional ClickHouse replicas and S3 buckets; configure lifecycle and encryption keys
Aggregation: implement anonymization transforms in replication pipeline for global aggregates
Backfill: build backfill jobs with checkpointing and idempotency
Console: add tenant residency control panel and replication status indicators
Testing: integration tests, fault-injection tests for network partitions, and performance benchmarks
Runbook: operational runbook for regional failover, replication lag escalation, and rollback
notes: 2026-03-10: Kickoff meeting. Decided on async replication to avoid user-facing latency. Action: Arjun to prototype routing in ingestion-gateway.
2026-03-12: Spike results: routing adds ~3ms median to ingestion path when residency lookup cached; recommend Redis local cache at each edge for tenant config.
2026-03-13: Security sign-off pending. Created PR to add KMS key-per-region support in infra: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123

2026-03-14: Implemented regional topic naming and basic router in staging ingestion-gateway (branch: feature/ENG-9427-region-routing). Load tests show 95th percentile replication lag ~40s for 10k events/sec.
Review feedback (2026-03-14): PM asked to include an explicit user opt-in flow for replicating aggregates to global cluster; added to tasks and acceptance criteria.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Cross-region replication could increase costs and operational complexity; mitigation: anonymize and aggregate before replicating to global cluster to reduce volume, use tiered retention, and allow tenant opt-out. Risk: Synchronous enforcement could increase tail latency; mitigation: use async route with local write-first and eventual consistency guarantees. Risk: Backfill large historical datasets may saturate network; mitigation: use bandwidth throttling, per-tenant windowed backfills, and resume checkpoints.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): deploy regional topic routing and local regional ClickHouse in staging for a subset of non-production tenants
Phase 2 (canary customers): enable residency controls for 3 low-risk customers in eu-west-1 and observe for 2 weeks
Phase 3 (tiered opt-in): open residency opt-in in Console for eligible enterprise customers; run backfill with throttles
Phase 4 (default enforcement): for new tenants created in regulated regions, set residency flag by default; monitor for issues and provide rollback path
